description: jmap-server/src/helpers.rs lines 137-152: the test is named 'now_utc_string_subsecond_uniqueness' and collects 10 results into a HashSet, but ends with 'let _ = seen; // used only to verify compilation' and explicitly discards any assertion. The comment above says 'this assertion is probabilistic' but there is no assertion at all — the test body only compiles the call. A reader must read to the end to discover the check was abandoned. Suggested rewrite: either assert seen.len() > 1 (with a #[ignore] and a comment about pathological environments), or rename the test to 'now_utc_string_compiles' and remove the HashSet collection entirely, so the test name matches what it actually verifies.
title: now_utc_string_subsecond_uniqueness test asserts nothing
